name: 小雨西游utf8
group_note: 小雨西游utf8 -- a separately-archived UTF8 repack of the 小雨西游/小雨西游Ⅱ codebase (same family as 003 unknownlib20150716 and 003-1 xiaoyuxiyou), confirmed NOT a byte-identical duplicate (8753 vs 11149 .lpc files -- a different content snapshot, not just a re-encoding of the same tree). WASM pass fixed 2 bugs, both genuine environment-limitation/latent-content issues rather than mudlib logic errors: (1) AGENTS.md §1.3(e)'s standing-policy uptime() startup-grace gate (destructs any connection in the driver's first 30s) -- this exact family (xiaoyuxiyou, unknownlib20150716) is explicitly named in that section as known-affected but was apparently never actually bypassed for either sibling (both still marked 'limited'); bypassed here by gating to non-loopback connections only, matching the documented standard patch. (2) adm/daemons/logind.lpc's encoding() calls the raw driver efun set_encoding("GBK")/set_encoding("big5") (not the mudlib's own int-based wrapper), which throws 'Fail to set encoding to GBK, error: U_FILE_ACCESS_ERROR' under WASM -- the bundled ICU data archive lacks a GBK converter. Since this archive is already a UTF-8-native repack (per its own name/branding), the transcoding call is vestigial; wrapped both calls in catch() rather than removing them, in case query_encoding() elsewhere depends on the object having attempted a set. Also has an extra 'press Enter to continue / Exit' prompt between GB/BIG5 selection and the actual login-id prompt that isn't present in some sibling family members -- documented in the README's registration-flow notes, not a bug. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/notices (WIZLIST points there, matching the family convention documented in xiaoyuxiyou's own README). Registration verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB select -> Enter (continue) -> new -> English id -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat menu (9 to accept, y to confirm) -> enters world, look/score both clean (one harmless printf("%O") debug-array leftover on look, pre-existing, not fixed -- purely cosmetic debug output). Admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 8753 .lpc files (8536 written, 31 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted, 186 unchanged; several file/directory names under daemon/class/spells/40/ contain leftover mojibake bytes from the original archive's filename encoding, formatted successfully regardless). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; 10 case-label-with-trailing-comment hits (combatd.lpc, natured.lpc, 5x maze/tupo40-N/npc/guai.lpc, newcloth.lpc, fabao.lpc, perform.lpc) all diff-reviewed clean -- every following statement/fallthrough preserved correctly. Post-formatter re-verified clean, admin permission still (admin). NOTE: siblings unknownlib20150716 and xiaoyuxiyou still have the SAME uptime() gate unfixed (both still marked 'limited') -- worth a follow-up pass to apply the same bypass and re-classify them.
